sloka: मैन्दं च द्विविदं नीलं गवाक्षं गजगोमुखौ।केसरिं हरिलोमानं विद्युदृंष्ट्रं च वानरम् ।। ६.७३.५८ ।।
transliteration: maindaṁ ca dvividaṁ nīlaṁ gavākṣaṁ gajagomukhau।kesariṁ harilomānaṁ vidyudṛṁṣṭraṁ ca vānaram ।। 6.73.58 ।।

translations.english: He rained a violent shower of tridents, swords and axes burning like sacrificial fire shedding flames with fire sparks on the Vanara army.
